default.description: Default capabilities for the main window

meshapp.description: Capability for sandboxed mesh-app webviews (windows labelled `meshapp-*`). Grants the minimal core surface needed to run a webview and reach the host over IPC (so `window.meshApp` works), but deliberately NOT shell / dialog / fs / updater — those plugin permissions stay scoped to the main window in default.json. NOTE: Tauri v2 does not gate app commands per-window (tauri#9227), so this capability cannot restrict WHICH app commands a meshapp window may invoke; isolation for first-party apps is the `crate::meshapp::authorize` install-grant gate plus the per-window CSP. True isolation for UNTRUSTED third-party apps additionally requires the deferred no-IPC bridge milestone.
